name: vision-audio
description: Vision Audio — личный аналог SoundCloud: web, Android, iOS, Windows, Linux

scripts.build:pages: VITE_LOCAL_MODE=1 BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/Vision/} OUT_DIR=dist-pages npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:local: tsx --test apps/web/src/local/client.test.ts apps/web/src/audio.test.ts apps/web/src/bulk/zip.test.ts apps/web/src/offline.test.ts apps/web/src/offline.cache.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/format.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/queue.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/media.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/downloads.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/sync.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/local.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/link.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/wave.test.ts apps/console/src/lib.test.ts apps/web/src/embed.test.ts apps/web/src/deep-link.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/deeplink.test.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/upload.test.ts apps/web/src/updates.test.ts apps/web/src/library-cache.test.ts apps/web/src/smart/smart-form.test.ts apps/web/src/crash-reporter.test.ts apps/web/src/now-playing.test.ts apps/web/src/track-menu.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:local && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:ffmpeg: FFMPEG_PATH=${FFMPEG_PATH:?укажите путь к ffmpeg} npm test
